parameter_matrix.note: Check PCB land pattern & height profile.
Wider operating Vin window supports broader rail & battery chemistry headroom.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.part_b_value: Ceramic OK · >=0 µF · Low-ESR MLCC compatible
parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CAUTION PACKAGE HEIGHT/PROFILE: NCP114ASN330T1G (TSOT-23-5) vs TLV73333PDBVR (SOT-23-5) share the same JEDEC land pattern pitch, but thin-profile TSOT (~1.0 mm) vs standard SOT (~1.45 mm) differs in body height; verify enclosure Z-clearance, SMT nozzle height, and solder fillet spec.
CAUTION OUTPUT CAPACITANCE: Minimum Cout differs significantly (NCP114ASN330T1G: 1 µF p.13 vs TLV73333PDBVR: 0 µF p.16); account for MLCC DC-bias derating.
engineering_verdict: NCP114ASN330T1G (onsemi, TSOT-23-5) and TLV73333PDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required replacements: while the footprint is physically compatible, engineering review and passive/circuit adjustments are mandatory due to minimum output capacitance requirement differs >= 2.5x. Key datasheet deltas: Iq is 50 µA (p.3) vs 34 µA (p.6), max output current is 300 mA (p.3) vs 300 mA (p.5), recommended Vin,max is 5.5 V (p.3) vs 5.5 V (p.5), typical dropout is 150 mV (p.3) vs 125 mV (p.6), and ceramic capacitor stability is supported vs supported. Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.4), thermal margin (θJA 236 vs 228.4 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
